mission.title: Hardline Hunter
mission.description: Find and secure two hardline junction boxes.

npc.say: Yikes! Oh, you scared me. Something weird is going on. Who are all these weird dudes in suits?

phase.briefing:
Thanks to the information that you gathered earlier, we now know that nexus points called "junction boxes" control the City's hardlines. If we can protect these boxes, we'll eliminate the threat of sabotage that has been hampering our recent operations in the Matrix.
Commander Lock believes that we have located one of these "junction boxes" near your position. Please search the indicated building and pinpoint the location of the junction box. Once you find the box, secure the area against any potential saboteurs. Zion is counting on you, Warrior!

enter.say: The junction box should be in that building. I'm picking up some powerful readings there--probably from the box.

done.say: You've located the box, and no hostiles in sight--good work, operative! In fact, you've done so well that I have another assignment for you. I'll contact you again once you're outside.

phase.briefing: All right. Our analysts have located another junction box near your location. Proceed to the building indicated by your waypoint and find this second box.

enter.say: You've reached the building, operative; now find the second box. I hope that those imposter Agents haven't managed to follow you there.

objective.text: Kill all of the imposter Agents

done.say: Well done, Warrior. You've secured the location against hostiles.
You may exit the area, Warrior.

mission.finish: Excellent work, {player}. At this rate we will soon have all the hardlines in the city secured against sabotage. Our enemies will realize that they cannot stop the progress of Zion!
